Evolution does not optimize for happiness — Quantum Leap (1989 TV series) shows exactly where that breaks. Quantum Leap is an American science fiction television series, created by Donald P. Bellisario, that aired on NBC for five seasons, from March 26, 1989, to May 5, 1993.
